research_basis: Official public YouTube Help only; channel revenue, audience size, ad fill, watch duration and production labor are not measured.

surfaces.name: Watch-page upload
surfaces.distribution: YouTube watch page, subscriptions and recommendations
surfaces.entry: Ordinary eligible uploaded video, including horizontal videos under 8 minutes
surfaces.ad_mechanism: Eligible monetized uploads 8 minutes or longer may enable mid-roll slots, but ads are separately selected

surfaces.name: Shorts Feed
surfaces.distribution: Shorts Feed, with separate public play starts
surfaces.entry: Square or vertical up to 3 minutes, using channel-type-specific date rules
surfaces.ad_mechanism: Shorts Feed Creator Pool sharing for eligible YPP creators, not watch-page mid-rolls
surfaces.transition: Classification depends on original upload date and channel type

surfaces.name: Live stream
surfaces.distribution: Real-time video, chat and channel live discovery
surfaces.entry: Eligibility and activation differ by live setup and creator account
surfaces.ad_mechanism: Eligible pre-roll and live mid-roll ads; fan support and memberships are separate money flows
surfaces.transition: May generate a separately visible archived replay after broadcast

surfaces.name: Premiere
surfaces.distribution: Scheduled or instant shared first viewing with live chat/reminders
surfaces.entry: Uploaded video using Premiere settings; Shorts and output over 1080p not supported in current policy
surfaces.ad_mechanism: Video monetization if eligible; Premiere is not a distinct guaranteed ad-rate tier
surfaces.transition: Becomes a regular channel upload afterwards; Premiere view count transfers to the video

surfaces.name: Clip
surfaces.distribution: Shareable looping selection attached to an accessible original video or stream
surfaces.entry: Clipping available under relevant video/channel settings
surfaces.ad_mechanism: No separately documented universal Clip payout; cannot infer independent gross revenue
surfaces.transition: Selection continues to depend on original video's visibility and rights

surfaces.name: Podcast playlist and episodes
surfaces.distribution: Episodes as videos in a designated playlist with potential YouTube Music features
surfaces.entry: Full-length owned episodes in a creator's podcast playlist; playlist may have product eligibility constraints
surfaces.ad_mechanism: Underlying episode/video revenue pathways apply when eligible; podcast designation is not a guaranteed independent payout
surfaces.transition: Same source episodes can exist as videos and playlist entries; avoid treating each playlist entry as an additional upload

surfaces.name: Archived live replay (VOD)
surfaces.distribution: Replay or highlights posted after live broadcast
surfaces.entry: YouTube may automatically archive streams shorter than 12 hours; longer streams may not be captured, so local backup is recommended
surfaces.ad_mechanism: If eligible, replay ads depend on VOD/watch-page monetization and demand; not equal to live ads
surfaces.transition: A recording with live history is not a new independently created person, channel or guaranteed second revenue

watch_page_midroll.notes: Natural breaks are more likely to serve ads, but ad demand and experience still determine delivery.

live_replay_comparison.selected_vendor_evidence: AIR's selected 404-channel sample offers bounded cross-channel evidence but lacks a representative new-entrant live-versus-replay experiment; it is not a census.

dated_policy_conflict.old_or_conflicting_version: General English Shorts 3-minute article still says any Short longer than 1 minute with an active Content ID claim is blocked.
dated_policy_conflict.new_or_conflicting_version: Localized Help article describes a relaxation from September 24, 2026 for new Shorts longer than one minute with claims.
dated_policy_conflict.publication_instruction: Do not assert a universal claim-blocking rule or universal exemption until official Help language, content owner type, market and upload-date requirements are reconciled.

verification_rules: Format type and surface must be declared before attaching any watch-time, views, CPM, ad-fill or paid-member claims.
Do not substitute public Shorts playback starts for eligible Shorts paid engaged/qualified views.
Mid-roll eligibility at 480 seconds means a slot can be enabled, not that an ad will be served or that longer is more profitable.
A live concurrent-viewer peak is not a count of unique viewers or a replay audience.
Premiere views transfer to the underlying upload; playlist membership and Clips are not additional unique content/people for summation.
Live and post-live ad revenues can be tracked separately by owner Analytics if provided, but must not be counted twice in a total.
An archived replay may never be available, so no live stream is guaranteed additional evergreen income.
Shorts music and Content ID policy conflicts must remain unresolved in this study until confirmed across official docs.
